prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a luxury high-fashion magazine cover. At the very top, place the magazine name LUMIÈRE in a massive elegant platinum-silver serif font, slightly transparent and overlapping the model's head like a high-end fashion masthead. Center an adult white woman with soft feminine features, big blue eyes, natural makeup, rosy cheeks and long platinum-blonde wavy hair flowing over one shoulder. She looks directly into the camera with a soft yet powerful gaze, head slightly tilted and posture naturally elegant. She wears a dramatic deep burgundy wine-red ballgown with a structured corset-inspired bodice, fitted mesh overlay, off-shoulder neckline and voluminous layered satin skirt billowing around her. Behind her shoulders, large sculptural fabric rises like rose petals. She leans slightly forward with both hands resting gently on her knees. Use a pure soft warm-white or ivory background, soft diffused light and no harsh shadows. Add the supplied typography: GRACE & POWER / THE NEW VISION OF LUXURY on the left, TIMELESS & FEARLESS / PURE OPULENCE on the right and ICONIC & UNSTOPPABLE at bottom right. Keep text integrated into the composition, not floating randomly. Ultra-photorealistic, 8K, real magazine-cover quality and vertical 9:13 format. Preserve the source gown, pose, typography and clean studio concept.
